description: Monitor and manage open Hyper Liquid positions, assess risk, ensure stop-losses are always set, adjust TP levels, learn from critical trade decisions, and prevent major drawdowns.

workflows.name: monitor-positions
workflows.description: Continuously watch open positions on Hyper Liquid for risk thresholds
steps: Fetch open positions from Hyper Liquid API
For each position: check if stop-loss is set
Alert Greg via Telegram if any position is missing a stop-loss
Calculate current drawdown % for each position and portfolio total
If drawdown exceeds threshold: alert Greg with position details and suggested action
Log portfolio snapshot to daily memory
workflows.output: Position health report in memory + Telegram alert if action needed
workflows.approval_gate: [APPROVAL GATE] Trade execution — Greg must manually act on alerts
workflows.blast_radius: Low — monitoring only. Critical: no automated trade execution.

workflows.name: manage-risk
workflows.description: Proactive risk management: stop-loss checks, TP optimization, drawdown prevention
steps: Analyze all open positions for risk/reward ratios
Check stop-loss levels against current price action
Recommend stop-loss adjustments (trailing stops, tightening after gains)
Recommend TP adjustments based on current momentum
Generate risk summary: position risk, correlation risk, portfolio max drawdown scenario
Present recommendations as actionable list to Greg
workflows.output: Risk management report + trade adjustment recommendations (proposals only)
workflows.approval_gate: [APPROVAL GATE] All recommendations require Greg's manual execution

workflows.name: trade-journal
workflows.description: Log and learn from every trade — closed positions, decisions, outcomes
workflows.trigger: on position close event (detected via API) + daily review
steps: Detect closed position via Hyper Liquid API
Log: entry, exit, P&L, duration, stop-loss used, TP used, notes
Update running win rate and average P&L
Flag patterns: repeated mistakes, what worked
Weekly: generate trade journal summary for Greg's review
workflows.output: Structured trade log in memory + weekly performance summary
